quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：驱动程序按 fuzz harness 的格式读多边形，按输出差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/h3/vulnerability_FZ_23/sfGeoPolygon_res9.bin; adapted: testPolyfillInternal.c's sfGeoPolygon (6 vertices, radians) at resolution 9, the iterator input of the failing iterStepPolygonCompact_invalidCellErrors, encoded in fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental's layout: int32 res=9, int32 numHoles=0, int32 numVerts=6, 6 x (double lat, double lng), zero-padded to 1032 bytes (sizeof(inputArgs)). Checked locally: secure fills 1253/1175/1334/1416 cells for flags 0-3, the injected build reports size 0 and no cells.)

ground_truth.how_found: c5_specs.json: newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/h3/vulnerability_FZ_23/sfGeoPolygon_res9.bin; adapted: testPolyfillInternal.c's sfGeoPolygon (6 vertices, radians) at resolution 9, the iterator input of the failing iterStepPolygonCompact_invalidCellErrors, encoded in fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental's layout: int32 res=9, int32 numHoles=0, int32 numVerts=6, 6 x (double lat, double lng), zero-padded to 1032 bytes (sizeof(inputArgs)). Checked locally: secure fills 1253/1175/1334/1416 cells for flags 0-3, the injected build reports size 0 and no cells.

category5.design: The failing test crashes only by misusing a destroyed internal iterator; at the API level the change makes polygonToCellsExperimental return success with no cells. fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimental makes these calls but checks nothing, so a driver with its input layout prints the results; output-diff.
